mapper.select: SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1

SELECT t.id AS trip_id, t.title, t.location, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.content, ( SELECT tai.image_path FROM trip_article_image tai WHERE tai.trip_article_id = t.id ORDER BY tai.order_number ASC, tai.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS main_image_path, t.status,
t.max_participants AS maxParticipants,
( SELECT COUNT(cp.id) FROM chat_room cr JOIN chat_participants cp ON cr.id = cp.chat_room_id WHERE cr.trip_article_id = t.id AND cp.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS current_participants_count FROM trip_article t WHERE t.host_user_id = #{hostId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC

SELECT tjr.id AS requestId, tjr.trip_article_id, tjr.applicant_user_id, tjr.status, tjr.created_at, u.nickname, u.gender, u.introduce, YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(u.birth) AS age FROM trip_join_request tjr JOIN users u ON tjr.applicant_user_id = u.id WHERE tjr.trip_article_id = #{tripArticleId} AND tjr.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY tjr.created_at ASC
SELECT tjr.id AS requestId, tjr.applicant_user_id AS applicantUserId, tjr.trip_article_id AS tripArticleId, tjr.status AS status FROM trip_join_request tjr WHERE tjr.id = #{requestId}
mapper.update: UPDATE trip_join_request SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{requestId}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM chat_room WHERE trip_article_id = #{tripArticleId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_participants (chat_room_id, user_id, status) VALUES (#{chatRoomId}, #{userId}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT ta.id, ta.host_user_id AS hostUserId, ta.location, ta.start_date AS startDate, ta.end_date AS endDate, ta.max_participants AS maxParticipants, ta.title, tjr.status AS applicationStatus, -- 현재 참여 인원도 카운트하여 함께 가져옵니다. tjr.id AS joinRequestId, ( SELECT tai.image_path FROM trip_article_image tai WHERE tai.trip_article_id = ta.id ORDER BY tai.image_path ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS mainImagePath, ( SELECT COUNT(cp.user_id) FROM chat_room cr JOIN chat_participants cp ON cr.id = cp.chat_room_id WHERE cr.trip_article_id = ta.id ) AS currentParticipants FROM trip_join_request tjr JOIN trip_article ta ON tjr.trip_article_id = ta.id WHERE tjr.applicant_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ta.id DESC
SELECT host_user_id FROM trip_article WHERE id = #{tripArticleId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE trip_article SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{tripArticleId}
